file_changes.publication_exception: GITLAB_TOKEN literal normalized to the full placeholder; source blob identity and credential-specific hashes omitted.

purpose: Mechanical refresh of the flattened GIFT source snapshot; no training implementation or runtime changes.

sanitization_exception.method: The full GITLAB_TOKEN literal was normalized to REPLACE_WITH_GITLAB_TOKEN. No literal, source blob identifier, or credential-specific hash is recorded.

source_bytes_origin: Source bytes were exported from the target and pinned Git objects in the optimization-task object database; no original working-tree files were copied.

verification.changed_components: Each refreshed component tree and its ordinary source files were checked against Git objects in the optimization-task object database, then rechecked on disk for path, SHA-256, size, mode, and symlink target bytes.
verification.layout: Final flattened path inventory matches the composed target source. No nested .git entries or task-index gitlinks remain under gift.
verification.reused_components: Unchanged recursive pins were not refetched; their flattened files were checked against the historical source-baseline.json SHA-256, size, and mode. The known publication-exception file was normalized again and checked by its sanitized full-file hash.
verification.training_or_runtime_checks: No training, tests, dependency installation, GPU jobs, or performance benchmarks were run; this is a source snapshot refresh only.
